risks: Explicit DAG only includes RS-MTG-01; its spec explicitly allows landing with live disabled. Its acceptance cannot substitute for canonical ACL/storage/SFU/native foundations.

Normative adapter points into absent apps/workspace-service/src; adding a file there without a running service/registry would be a misleading scaffold. Lead must reconcile service placement with published spec before implementation.
Changing provider decision alone leaves joinRoom, joinNativeRoom and gateMeetingConationShell unavailable/queued; three distinct gates need a clean room-only cutover.

Current ROOM_JOIN trust boundary accepts body actor and ignores workspace/context; recordingConsent is hardcoded. Never enable this path before transport identity and fresh authorization are established.

MeetingRepository.pending workspace filter contains || true; file journal commandId dedupe has no payload hash conflict and is not a shared Postgres/outbox transaction. Reusing it for live calls risks cross-workspace events and duplicate provider side effects.
Media hardware identifiers are not registered ROX device IDs. The renderer's desktop/local-actor grant defaults and guest boolean cannot prove identity/device ownership.

Guest expiry/revoke needs active ejection including crash/recovery reconciliation; a database flag or waiting for token TTL fails published DoD. Reconnect can resurrect access without fresh policy checks.
One sourceBinding and capture statuses cannot silently serve local recording plus provider room/participation/archive; protect existing local files and singleton recording behavior.

Proposed CallParticipants is named in scope but no implementation seam was found in bounded search; compose participant display within normative LiveCallView or reuse a lead-delivered component, not an invented extra owned file.
Existing room assertions are dominated by undecided state; their green status, if run later unchanged, would not prove actor/webhook/security behavior. No test outcome is claimed here.
